paper_metadata.title: Application of quantum computing algorithms for optimization of tactical asset allocation in portfolio management

experiments.description: QAOA applied to tactical asset allocation / portfolio optimization by encoding a quadratic binary optimization problem derived from mean-variance style portfolio selection and return-deviation minimization.

algorithm.variant: standard QAOA for portfolio optimization / TAA

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Binary portfolio weights x_i in {0,1} are mapped to an Ising formulation via z_i in {+1,-1}; the paper states a fully connected Ising Hamiltonian but does not give a qubit-per-asset count or discretization beyond binary variables.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize a quadratic programming objective for portfolio optimization / return-deviation minimization, described generically as maximizing returns while minimizing risk, with penalty terms for budget constraints and a Sharpe-ratio-related formulation.
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Penalty term / Lagrange multiplier used to enforce budget constraint.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Fully connected Ising Hamiltonian derived from the QUBO formulation; explicit coefficients are not fully specified in the text.

problem_instance.description: Portfolio optimization / tactical asset allocation problem using actual daily market price data over an 8-year timeframe; the paper cites a search over 10,382 candidate portfolios and a portfolio consisting of 52 assets.

dataset_specification.description: Actual daily market price data over an 8-year timeframe; no ticker list, date range, or train/test split provided.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Construct QUBO / Ising formulation from portfolio optimization objective and constraints.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Decode the portfolio solution from the measured ground-state approximation / low-energy state.

speedup_claims.conditions: according to the cited research, for a portfolio of 52 assets and 10,382 candidate portfolios using actual daily market price data over an 8-year timeframe
speedup_claims.caveats: This is a claim about expected quantum capability, not a reported experimental benchmark in the paper; no measured quantum runtime is provided.

complexity_analysis.wall_clock_classical: approximately two days for the cited classical computation

experiments.description: VQE applied to tactical asset allocation / portfolio optimization by minimizing the expectation value of an Ising Hamiltonian derived from a quadratic portfolio objective.

algorithm.variant: standard VQE for portfolio optimization / TAA

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Portfolio weights are encoded into a binary quadratic form and then mapped to an Ising Hamiltonian with Pauli-Z operators; the paper does not specify a qubit count or discretization granularity.
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize the expectation value of the Hamiltonian corresponding to the portfolio optimization objective (risk-return tradeoff with budget penalty).
problem_formulation.constraints_handling: Penalty term / Lagrange multiplier for budget constraint.
problem_formulation.problem_hamiltonian: Qubit Hamiltonian / Ising Hamiltonian; explicit operator decomposition is not provided.

problem_instance.description: Same portfolio optimization / tactical asset allocation setting as the QAOA discussion, using real market data and a 52-asset portfolio context.

dataset_specification.description: Actual daily market price data over an 8-year timeframe; no further dataset details provided.

implementation_details.classical_preprocessing: Formulate the portfolio optimization problem as a Hamiltonian / QUBO objective.
implementation_details.classical_postprocessing: Measure the quantum state and interpret the lowest-energy state as the portfolio solution.

speedup_claims.caveats: The paper describes VQE conceptually for portfolio optimization but does not report experimental performance numbers, runtime, or benchmark comparisons.
